## Checklist

- [ ] `tests/run.ps1` passes (tests **and** evals) — CI will check it again
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] New UI text exists in **both** Hebrew and English
- [ ] UI change: checked in Hebrew (RTL) and at phone width — screenshot below
- [ ] Structure, stored keys, limits or a decision changed → `architecture.md` and the SPEC decision log updated
- [ ] `README.md` updated if something a user sees or runs changed
- [ ] No personal data (real timetable, grades, teacher names, tokens, private links)
